data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is a reduction ("reduces to the Coordination Decay mechanism"), but the falsification condition is formulated at the wrong level for a reduction claim. A genuine reduction is refuted by showing the reduced-to mechanism cannot account for the phenomenon or that the original has essential properties absent from the reducing base. Instead, the target refutes only a contingent downstream factor — whether automated patching closes the vulnerability window — which leaves the reduction itself untested: coordination decay could still be the structural mechanism even if automated patching mitigates one manifestation.
